🔥 scanopy | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate and maintain accurate network documentation and visualization, eliminating the need for manual drawing and ensuring the documentation reflects the current state of the infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Automatic network discovery and mapping • Multiple documentation views (L2, L3, workloads, applications) • Distributed scanning capabilities • Docker and SNMP integration
📖 Summary: Scanopy is a Rust-based tool that automatically generates up-to-date network documentation by scanning infrastructure. It provides multiple views of the network, including L2, L3, workloads, and applications, replacing static diagrams with a continuously maintained model.
